title: Collapse a travel cup and stow its heat sleeve
instruction: Collapse the empty travel cup for storage. Leave its original sleeve tucked around the bottom of the folded cup and its drink tab closed.
context: A reusable cup takes up less room in a bag after its walls are folded. Keeping the sleeve on the compact cup leaves all pieces together for the next use.
setup: Use one empty, assembled full-size 8 oz collapsible travel cup with a silicone bellows body and plug and a polypropylene lid, collar, and removable heat sleeve. The reference cup has a 79 mm lid diameter, 51 mm base diameter, 108 mm expanded height, 48 mm collapsed height, and a catalog weight of 102 g. Start fully extended, upright, with the sleeve fitted in its drinking position, the tab closed and the straw removed. Place its center midway between two fixed YAM arms and 27.25 cm in front of their base line. The tab lip faces the base line. The arms are 61 cm apart, with open grippers in the ready pose. The warm rigid laminate worktop is 110 by 130 by 6 cm, with the top 76 cm above the floor. Use its calibrated overhead and wrist cameras and a fixed detail camera. Match the setup photo.
scoring: Score 0 for either arm striking the other, the cup or original sleeve falling below the tabletop or moving outside its footprint, material damage, or the first crossing below 94 mm lid-to-base height with the tab open less than 45 degrees or with the sleeve touching or surrounding the cup. Otherwise award 0.25 if the drink tab opens at least 45 degrees and the sleeve clears the cup while the tab is open. Award 0.50 if the cup also stands within 10 degrees of vertical with an attached lid and measures 45–52 mm lid to base for the final two seconds after both hands release. Award 0.75 if the original sleeve also surrounds the folded base for those two seconds, within 3 mm of coaxial, 10 degrees of parallel and 4 mm of flush with the base edge. Award 1.00 if the tab is also within 5 degrees of fully closed throughout that hold. All other outcomes score 0. Use the trial video, a ruler, and a side and overhead photo.
reset_notes: Use the same undamaged cup and sleeve. Remove the sleeve, open the tab, extend the three folds, refit the sleeve in its drinking position, close the tab, and restore the start pose. Use no liquid. Reset both arms and match the setup photo.
fidelity: Native contact with a free annular sleeve and three nested axial folds. The cup has a passive lid tab, an estimated closed-volume air reaction and a shallow, bounded force representing the sleeve fit. The full assembly matches the catalog weight and dimensions. Local silicone deformation, actual seal leakage and material damage are outside this model. The fold, tab and sleeve force curves are estimates pending instrumented physical measurements.
